snippet.title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads - A Mini Action Defense Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Part city builder, part retro vehicle shooter. Tear down the ruins of the old world and use what you find to build a settlement. Rescue survivors from the wastes. Defend your people against waves of attacks from the rogue AI that ruined the old world.  Procedural levels and random build order make every run unique.  Coming later in 2025.  

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3580340/Ash__Adams_Existential_Treads/
